guesses.reason: The warm golden-red coat, soft feathering on the ears and chest, and friendly broad head strongly suggest Golden Retriever ancestry.
The crisp white blaze down the face, white muzzle and chest, and semi-folded ears are typical of a red-and-white Aussie or similar herding mix.
The symmetrical white facial stripe, white collar markings, and lean medium build resemble a red-and-white Border Collie.
